# Crystal mod:
### 20 gems, seamless ore and crystal generation; 
## gem pickaxes & swords, shimmer quartz 
![pickaxe varieties](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1226d201cb9fd1db96084c7be70c76d05485a245.png)
### Crystals that Grow
| Clear Quartz |
| Rose Quartz | 
| Fire Quartz |
| Golden Healer Quartz | 
| Smoky Quartz | 
| Citrine |
| Blue Jennamite |  EDIBLE
| Green Jennamite | EDIBLE

### Crystals that don't grow (Must be Mined) 
| Black Tourmaline | 
| Blue Lace Agate | 
| Aquamarine | 
| Garden Quartz | 
| Fluorite | 
| Ocean Jasper | 
| Kunzite | 
| Flower Agate | 
| Labradorite | 
| Moonstone | 
| Carnelian |
| Malachite | 
| Selenite |
![stones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66186083f70e6c1988f80b9d87e8ba37de69e08a_0.webp)
How it works:
1. all crystals have ores that spawn seamlessly with various rates
2. ores begin "budding" into large crystals that eventually become crystal blocks.
3. crystal blocks begin budding themselves into more crystals that become more crystal blocks.
4. once there are 15 crystal blocks max in an area, they stop growing. Not all crystals grow. 

Break the ore to get Specimens 
Break the clusters to get Pocket Stones 
JEI enabled
